provenanceLegend.explicit: A source row states it directly (lineage CSV, workbook extract, entity key list, Oracle table index).
provenanceLegend.inferred: Computed by a naming rule or co-occurrence. Not emitted in this build (statedOnly).
provenanceLegend.curated: Hand-authored rule kept in the repo (config/functionalAreas.ts).

workbookExtract.note: Extracted once from Data_Lineage_NS_NSDI_4.0.xlsx by scripts/extract-workbook.py

dataModels.note: Oracle NSAW Data Models diagrams, 26R4: each diagram states the fact's relationships with its dimensions; no join columns

meta.derivedDefinition: A physical column is derived when it is flagged in nsaw_derived.csv (code 1) OR its table matches isNsawGeneratedTable (code 2); 3 = both. Table.derivedRule says which fired.
meta.roleDefinition: parsePhysicalTableType() after stripping a trailing _SEC; isSecured is a separate flag.
meta.statedOnlyNote: Only relationships stated in Oracle's files are emitted. Dropped: name-guessed sourcedFrom/loadedFrom and their NetSuite records/fields, concepts + instanceOf, securedVariantOf (and physicalTable.baseTable), entityOf, readsFrom, usedWith (usedwith.json is empty), busMatrix.saPairs. Kept naming conventions that are not relationships: table role by suffix, isSecured (_SEC), derived by isNsawGeneratedTable.
